description: This is a Streamlit-based Python source file for a web page that allows users to upload PDF files of medical textbook chapters, process them by extracting text, generating embeddings, and storing metadata and embeddings in a vector store. It also displays existing chapters with options to delete them.

classes.name: LangchainPDFProcessor
classes.description: Class responsible for processing PDF files and extracting text chunks.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: Class responsible for generating text embeddings asynchronously.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: Class managing the local vector database for storing embeddings.

methods.name: get_embeddings
methods.description: Asynchronous function to batch embed a list of text chunks using EmbeddingManager.
